vault_mismatch_desc: Backup kun furtu encryption adda ta'en hojjatame. Bindeen akkuma jiranitti seenu — furtu gaddanal duraa galchuun si barbaachisu danda'a dubbisuuf.
guide_notes_p1: Filadhu barruu kamiyyuu Bold ykn Italic gochuuf toolbar fayannde irraa — aɗa waawi jillunde ɗee ɗiɗi fof dow kelme wootere.
guide_notes_p2: Fakkiilee galmee kee ykn kaamera irraa kallattiin mbinde keessatti dabali; nateen bakka tokkotti kuifamu e cummii ta'anii hafu.
guide_notes_p3: Mbinde gubbaa doggol kee keessatti faddat gochuuf hidhi — ɓoccu ⋮ menu walla fiy dow kaartal ngam tiggude walla tiggitte.
guide_checklist_p1: Mallattoo tammaari hojjatameera gochuuf mallatteessi; sort icon cuqaasi bakka jijjiiruuf: Haa dursa hafu, Haa dursa xumuramu, ykn doggol A→Z.
guide_checklist_p2: Layin gadii dhiibi battalatti dhabamsiisuuf. Ilaalchi gabaabaan tammaari fof andal goorratti agarsiisa.
guide_checklist_p3: Kaartal mbinde baay'ina tammaari fof e hammam akka xumurame agarsiisa — ilaalcha ariifataa mbinde otuu hin banin.
guide_itinerary_p1: Galmeen bakka kamiyyuu maqaa bakkaa, yeroo gahuu, yeroo ka'uu, e ngesa binde galmee qabachuu ykn daandii qaba.
guide_itinerary_p2: Guyyaa ykn yeroo galmee kamiyyuu irra jiru cuqaasi cuftirgal banuuf e re-schedule gochuuf — galmeen otomatikiin yeroo hordofa.
guide_itinerary_p3: Kaartal mbinde baay'ina bakka fof agarsiisa mbele o argu laawol kee fof ilaalcha tokkoon.
guide_meal_plan_p1: Andal guyyaa kamiyyuu slots Kacitaari, Bottaari, Hiraande, e Snacks qaba — slot duudaa dhiisi ykn dhabamsiisi yoo hin barbaachisne. Andaloota dabali akkuma barbaadamutti.
guide_meal_plan_p2: Slot nyaataa cuqaasi maqaa nyaataa barreessuuf ykn binde gabaabaa maandinki piriiri dabaluuf; jijjiiramni otomatikiin kuifama.
meal_plan_p3: Kaartal mbinde guyyaa meeqa akka piriiri hojjatame agarsiisa, njiiltong gabaabaa kenna otuu hin banin mbinde fof.
guide_recipe_p1: Yeroo piriiri, yeroo hottol, e servings gubbaatti dabali — servings kaartal mbinde irratti agarsiifama noddaango yaawðe.
guide_recipe_p2: Geɗe maqaa e baay'inaan dabali; handal andal kamiyyuu irra jiru dhiibi reorder nane re dhabamsiisuu e dabaluu.
guide_recipe_p3: Laabi otomatikiin lakkaa'amu — laawol kamiyyuu galchi doggol keessatti e lakkoofsi ofiin nappy ta'a.
guide_drawing_p1: Filadhu Pen, Highlighter, walla Eraser iwde e toolbar ley; re-adjust mbeela nate e ngol nane maa a waɗ nate.
guide_drawing_p2: Undo e redo kala stroke feere-feere e buttons ↩ / ↪ — jogu kala button ngam yaawde e laawol taariindi.
guide_drawing_p3: Ɓoccu Export Image e nder toolbar ngam danndude nate maa e suudu nate kaangadi no full-resolution PNG.
guide_security_p1: Bindeen fof e nate mbeela AES-256 furtu kee irraa fudhatameen cummii ta'a — dubbifamuu hin danda'u malee isaa.
guide_security_p2: Caggal banuun dursa sirrii ta'e, Settings jalatti biometrics banadhu ariifachisuuf fingerprint ykn Face ID.
guide_security_p3: Icon 🔒 boccoor kaartal mbinde irra jiru mbinde cummii furtu jooniitiin jechuudha. Icon orange furtu addaatiin cummii jechuudha — furtu gaddanal galchi dubbisuuf.
guide_sync_p1: Liggito e Google ley Settings → Account; ɓoccu Upload walla Restore ngam push walla pull — liggito e account gooto dow kala kaangadi.
guide_sync_p2: Caggal re-install, liggito e ɓoccu Restore from Drive — application oo ina waddata encryption salt maa mbele kala binde ina coktitte no laabi.
guide_sync_p3: Si mbinde wootere waɗira waylo-waylo dow kaangadi ɗiɗi, toraare ina holla mbele aɗa suftu Keep Local, Keep Remote, walla Keep Both.
guide_controls_p1: Ɓoccu kaartal mbinde ngam udditde ɗum; fiy dow kala kaartal ngam udditde multi-select mode — caggal ɗum ɓoccu kaartaaji goɗɗi ngam hokkude e suftirgal.
guide_controls_p2: Ɓoccu kaartal ley nano ngam fusaade ɗum. E nder mbinde, ɓoccu ⋮ ngam tiggude, waylude mbeela, waylude nokku, hokkude nate, walla fusaade mbinde ndee.
guide_controls_p3: Ɓoccu icon gite 👁 dow kala kaartal ngam njiiltong mbinde nane maa a uddit editor — ina wallit ngam janngude yaawɗe alaa iwde e doggol.
guide_organisation_p1: Ɓoccu icon 🔍 e nder bar dow ngam ɗabbude dow kala binde — njiiltong ina hottat tiitooɗe, mbinde, tammaari, nokkuuji, ñaamri, e laawol hottol fof ndeen ndeen.
guide_organisation_p2: Ɓoccu icon sort ngam waylude hakkunde: Ko hecci aduna, Ko ɓeeɗi aduna, walla njiiltong Category — e nder njiiltong Category kala kala (General, Work, Personal, Ideas) ina waawi collapsed.
guide_organisation_p3: Waɗ category dow kala mbinde e nder editor e nder chip row ley tiitoonde; waɗ mbeela e ⋮ → Change Color ngam njiili binde ɗee e njiiltong wootere.
faq_lock_icon_q: Ko firi mbinde am ina holla icon coktirgal orange e mbinde coktirgal feere?
faq_lock_icon_a: Icon coktirgal orange ina firi mbinde ndee cummii e coktirgal gaddanal jooni feere e ngal liggito jooni. Ɗum ina waɗa si application re-installed e coktirgal gaddanal kesal waɗiraa. Hokku coktirgal gaddanal gaddanal ngal waɗiraa aduna ngam heɓde laawol heen.
faq_forgot_password_q: Hanti si mi yejjitii coktirgal am gaddanal?
faq_forgot_password_a: Binde ɗee ina cummii end-to-end e AES-256 e coktirgal ngal waawaa artirde e kala neɗɗo — haa e developer oo. Si a jogi Google Drive backup waɗiraa nane aɗa anndi coktirgal ngal, artir ɗum e hokku coktirgal potngal. Alaa coktirgal gaddanal, binde cummii ɗee heɓataa laawol. Kisal maa firi doggol ngol.
faq_sync_devices_q: No mbe'al mi sync binde dow kaangadi?
faq_sync_devices_a: Yahu e Settings → Account e liggito e account Google gooto dow kala kaangadi. Ɓoccu Sync Now ngam upload walla download. Caggal re-install dow kaangadi kesal, liggito aduna e caggal ɗum ɓoccu Restore from Drive — application oo ina waddata encryption salt maa mbele coktirgal maa ina waawa coktitte fof.
faq_notes_missing_q: Ko firi binde am njiiltaa caggal re-install?
faq_notes_missing_a: Binde nokkuure ina njiilto dow kaangadi e ina fusa si a fusii application oo. Si Drive sync waɗiraa, liggito kadi ley Settings → Account e ɓoccu Restore from Drive. Si a naltii JSON backup e nder Settings → Storage → Download Notes JSON, ɓoccu Upload Notes JSON ngam artirde ɗum.
faq_no_account_q: Mbe'al mi waawi liggito e NoteLiha alaa account?
faq_no_account_a: Eyyo — kala binde ɗee njee6o (Note, Checklist, Itinerary, Meal Plan, Recipe, Drawing) ina liggito offline alaa account toraade. Binde ɗee ina njiilto e ina cummii dow kaangadi. Account ina toraa si aɗa yiɗi Google Drive sync walla cross-device backup.
faq_export_backup_q: No mbe'al mi naltat walla backup binde am?
faq_export_backup_a: Gese ɗee ina woodi jooni tan ngam Google Synced Users. Yahu e Settings → Storage e ɓoccu Download Notes JSON ngam danndude fiilde backup cummiinde dow kaangadi maa. Ngam artirde, ɓoccu Upload Notes JSON e suftu fiilde ndee. Binde ɗee keddotocoo ko cummii e nder fiilde ndee, ndeen danndude ɗum kala nokku ina selli.
faq_canvas_preview_q: Ko firi canvas oo yiyata feere e njiiltong doggol?
faq_canvas_preview_a: Kaartal mbinde ina holla nate thumbnail piriiri ngam performance laawol. Nate full-resolution ndee ina danndu kala laawol — ɓoccu mbinde ngam udditde full size. Thumbnail oo ina re-fresh kala laawol a danndii.
faq_biometrics_a: Caggal hokkude coktirgal gaddanal no laabi aduna, aɗa waawi enrol biometrics ley Settings. Caggal ɗum si udditii fingerprint walla Face ID ina holla aduna. Si biometrics yaanaani walla fusii, application oo ina hooti dow weeco coktirgal gaddanal.
faq_reorder_checklist_q: Mbe'al mi waawi reorder walla sort tammaari ɗee?
faq_reorder_checklist_a: Eyyo. E nder mbinde doggol tammaari, ɓoccu icon sort e nder toolbar ngam waylude hakkunde manual order, A→Z, Z→A, Ko faddat aduna, walla Ko gasat aduna. Aɗa waawi kadi drag kala tammaari e handal mum ngam waɗde ɗum nokku mo njiɗ-aa — sort mode maa ina jogito kala mbinde.
faq_delete_note_q: No mbe'al mi fusata mbinde haa laabi?
faq_delete_note_a: Ɓoccu kaartal mbinde ley nano ngam holla laawol fusaade, walla fiy dow ngam udditde multi-select mode e fusaade kaartaaji goɗɗi kadi. Binde pusaade ɗee ina yahu Recycle Bin — uddit Settings → Recycle Bin ngam artirde walla fusaade haa laabi.
faq_recover_note_q: Mi fusii mbinde e sabaabu sifa — mbe'al mi artirat ɗum?
faq_recover_note_a: Eyyo. Binde pusaade ɗee fusataa ndeen ndeen — aduna ina yahu Recycle Bin. Uddit Settings → Recycle Bin, suftu mbinde maa, e ɓoccu Restore ngam artirde ɗum. Binde ɗee ina iwda haa laabi tan si a ɓoccii Empty Recycle Bin, ndeen a jogi waktu ngam artirde sifa maa.
faq_share_note_a: Fiy dow mbinde e ɓoccu icon Share ngam neldu no plain text. Kufol ngol ina waɗa sifa kala sifa — doggol tammaari ina jogi tick state, recipe ina holla geɗe e laabi, itinerary ina holla kala nokku e ñalngu e waktu mum. Ngam jillunde binde goɗɗi kadi, fiy dow kaartal ngam udditde multi-select mode, suftu limoore mo njiɗ-aa, caggal ɗum ɓoccu icon share e nder bar dow.
faq_change_colour_q: No mbe'al mi waylata mbeela mbinde?
faq_change_colour_a: Uddit mbinde e ɓoccu ⋮ → Change Color ngam suftude e mbeela mbeelaaji ɗee (no Sunset, Lavender, Rose, e Forest). Mbeela suftu6e ina holla no accent strip dow kaartal mbinde e nder doggol ngol, ndeen njiili binde ɗee e njiiltong wootere ina yaawi. Mbeela ɗee ina waɗa kala mbinde e ina waawi waylude kala waktu.
